params.name: Mod Wheel
params.desc: The modulation wheel is typically used to control the amount of modulation in a patch

params.name: Mute
params.desc: Clickless muting of Muse's MAIN OUT signal

params.name: Glide Time
params.desc: Increasing the glide control will increase the amount of time it takes to move from one note to the next, creating a portamento effect

params.name: Timbre Volume
params.desc: Volume control for the currently active timbre (A/B) before it reaches the voice summing busses

params.name: Pan Spread
params.desc: Spreads allocated voices apart giving a wider feel to the stereo image

params.name: Pan
params.desc: Bipolar control for manual adjustment of the pan-position of the currently active timbre (A/B) in the stereo field

params.name: LFO 1 Rate
params.desc: Controls the frequency of LFO 1

params.name: LFO 1 Waveform
params.usage: 0-24: Triangle; 25-49: Saw; 50-74: Square; 75-99: Random; 100-127: User Wave
params.desc: Selects the wave shape of LFO 1

params.name: LFO 2 Rate
params.desc: Controls the frequency of LFO 2

params.name: LFO 2 Waveform
params.usage: 0-24: Triangle; 25-49: Saw; 50-74: Square; 75-99: Random; 100-127: User Wave
params.desc: Selects the wave shape of LFO 2

params.name: Pitch LFO Rate
params.desc: Control the frequency of the PITCH LFO

params.name: Pitch LFO Shape
params.desc: Bipolar control adjusting the angle of the PITCH LFO's waveform

params.name: Pitch LFO Amount
params.desc: Bipolar control over the depth of the PITCH LFO's modulation of its hardwired destinations

params.name: Pitch LFO OSC 1
params.desc: Routes the PITCH LFO to modulate OSCILLATOR 1 when engaged

params.name: Pitch LFO OSC 2
params.desc: Routes the PITCH LFO to modulate OSCILLATOR 2 when engaged

params.name: Pitch LFO Mod OSC
params.desc: Routes the PITCH LFO to modulate the MODULATION OSCILLATOR when engaged

params.name: Pitch LFO Detune
params.desc: Routes the PITCH LFO to modulate the DETUNE knob in the VOICE CONTROL section when engaged

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Frequency
params.desc: Controls the frequency of the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Audio
params.desc: Sets the modulation oscillator to operate at audio-rate frequencies

params.name: Modulation Oscillator KB Track
params.desc: Enables keyboard control of the frequency of the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Waveform
params.desc: Selects the waveform of the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator KB Reset
params.desc: Resets the LFO to its starting point in its wave cycle every time a key is pressed

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Unipolar
params.desc: Enabled unipolar mode for the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Pitch Amount
params.desc: Determines the depth at which frequency modulation of the oscillator section occurs based on the OSC 1 and OSC 2 routing buttons

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Pitch OSC 1
params.desc: Enables frequency modulation of OSC 1 via the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Pitch OSC 2
params.desc: Enables frequency modulation of OSC 2 via the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator PWM Amount
params.desc: Determines the depth at which pulse width modulation of the oscillator section occurs based on the OSC 1 and OSC 2 routing buttons

params.name: Modulation Oscillator PWM OSC 1
params.desc: Enables modulation of the duty cycle of the OSC 1 pulse/square waveshape via the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator PWM OSC 2
params.desc: Enables modulation of the duty cycle of the OSC 2 pulse/square waveshape via the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Filter Amount
params.desc: Determines the depth at which cutoff frequency modulation of the filter section occurs based on the FILTER 1 and FILTER 2 routing buttons

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Filter 1
params.desc: Enables cutoff frequency modulation of FILTER 1 via the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator Filter 2
params.desc: Enables cutoff frequency modulation of FILTER 2 via the modulation oscillator

params.name: Modulation Oscillator VCA Amount
params.desc: Determines the depth at which the MODULATION OSCILLATOR will modulate the amplitude of the VCA, providing a tremolo effect

params.name: Modulation Oscillator VCA PAN
params.desc: Enables pan-position modulation of a voice in the stereo field by inverting the phase of the modulation oscillator sent to the right VCA

params.name: Oscillator 1 Octave
params.desc: Selects the octave for OSC 1

params.name: Oscillator 1 Frequency
params.desc: Detunes OSC 1 from the pitch associated with a keyboard note

params.name: Oscillator 2 Octave
params.desc: Selects the octave for OSC 2

params.name: Oscillator 2 Frequency
params.desc: Detunes OSC 2 from the pitch associated with a keyboard note
